title: Learning To Walk
description: Bài đọc về tác hại của bề mặt phẳng đối với sức khoẻ và các giải pháp

words.example: These days the feet of a typical city dweller rarely encounter terrain any more uneven than a crack in the pavement.
words.collocation: city dweller · urban dweller · cave dweller

words.example: These days the feet of a typical city dweller rarely encounter terrain any more uneven than a crack in the pavement.
words.collocation: encounter problems · encounter difficulties · encounter resistance
words.note: Cũng dùng như danh từ: 'a chance encounter' (cuộc gặp tình cờ).

words.example: Factory workers were asked to try standing on a variable terrain floor.
words.collocation: rough terrain · uneven terrain · difficult terrain

words.example: By flattening our urban environment we have put ourselves at risk of a surprising number of chronic illnesses and disabilities.
words.collocation: chronic illness · chronic pain · chronic disease
words.note: Trái nghĩa: acute (cấp tính). Rất hay gặp trong chủ đề Health.

words.example: Research into the idea that flat floors could be detrimental to our health was pioneered back in the late 1960s.
words.collocation: detrimental to health · detrimental effect · detrimental impact
words.note: Trang trọng hơn 'harmful'. Luôn đi với 'to': detrimental to + N.

words.example: Research into the idea that flat floors could be detrimental to our health was pioneered back in the late 1960s.
words.collocation: pioneer research · pioneer a technique · pioneer the use of
words.note: Cũng dùng như danh từ: 'a pioneer in the field' (người tiên phong trong lĩnh vực).

words.example: Brantingham and Beekman were concerned with the growing epidemic of high blood pressure.
words.collocation: growing epidemic · obesity epidemic · epidemic of
words.note: Nghĩa bóng: sự lan tràn (không chỉ bệnh). So sánh: pandemic (đại dịch toàn cầu).

words.example: They reckoned the problems might be linked to the uniformity of the surfaces that we tend to stand and walk on.
words.collocation: lack of uniformity · uniformity of · achieve uniformity
words.note: Tính từ: uniform.

words.example: These surfaces are likely to be far more conducive to chronic stress syndromes than natural surfaces.
words.collocation: conducive to learning · conducive to growth · conducive environment
words.note: Luôn đi với 'to': conducive to + N/V-ing.

words.example: These surfaces are likely to be far more conducive to chronic stress syndromes than natural surfaces.
words.collocation: chronic syndrome · stress syndrome · syndrome of

words.example: Modern lifestyles waste all this potential flexibility.
words.collocation: greater flexibility · lack of flexibility · offer flexibility
words.note: Tính từ: flexible. Hay dùng trong cả nghĩa đen (cơ thể) và nghĩa bóng (tư duy).

words.example: Brantingham and Beekman became convinced that the damage could be rectified by making people wobble.
words.collocation: rectify the situation · rectify a mistake · rectify a problem
words.note: Trang trọng hơn 'fix' hoặc 'correct'.

words.example: This modest irregularity allowed the soles of the volunteers' feet to deviate slightly from the horizontal.
words.collocation: deviate from the norm · deviate from the plan · deviate significantly
words.note: Danh từ: deviation.

words.example: This modest irregularity allowed the soles of the volunteers' feet to deviate slightly from the horizontal.
words.collocation: modest improvement · modest income · modest amount
words.note: Trong ngữ cảnh học thuật thường mang nghĩa 'nhỏ, không đáng kể'.

words.example: This simple intervention made a huge difference, within a few weeks.
words.collocation: government intervention · medical intervention · early intervention
words.note: Động từ: intervene. Rất hay gặp trong IELTS Writing Task 2.

words.example: Even if people were wobbling slightly, it activated a host of muscles in their legs.
words.collocation: activate muscles · activate a system · activate a response

words.vi: Sự tuần hoàn, sự lưu thông
words.example: The muscle action prevented the pooling of blood, reducing the stress on the heart and circulation.
words.collocation: blood circulation · poor circulation · improve circulation
words.note: Cũng dùng cho báo chí: 'newspaper circulation' (số phát hành).

words.example: Fisher and colleagues designed a mat intended to replicate the effect of walking on cobblestones.
words.collocation: replicate the results · replicate an experiment · difficult to replicate
words.note: Hay dùng trong ngữ cảnh nghiên cứu khoa học.

words.vi: Khả năng di chuyển, tính cơ động
words.example: After 16 weeks, these people showed marked improvements in mobility.
words.collocation: social mobility · improve mobility · reduced mobility
words.note: Tính từ: mobile.

words.example: Reflexologists have long advocated walking on textured surfaces to stimulate so-called 'acupoints' on the soles of the feet.
words.collocation: advocate for · strongly advocate · advocate a policy
words.note: Danh từ: advocate /ˈæd.və.kət/ (người ủng hộ) — khác cách đọc.

words.example: Reflexologists have long advocated walking on textured surfaces to stimulate so-called 'acupoints' on the soles of the feet.
words.collocation: stimulate growth · stimulate the economy · stimulate interest
words.note: Danh từ: stimulation. Tính từ: stimulating.

words.example: In China, spas, apartment blocks and even factories promote their cobblestone paths as healthful amenities.
words.collocation: local amenities · public amenities · basic amenities
words.note: Thường dùng ở số nhiều: amenities.

words.example: Forces in the joint are reduced, putting less strain on the system.
words.collocation: put strain on · under strain · muscle strain
words.note: Cũng dùng như động từ: 'strain a muscle' (căng cơ).

words.example: A weekend or even a few hours spent in the countryside could help alleviate a sufferer's aches and pains.
words.collocation: alleviate pain · alleviate poverty · alleviate the problem
words.note: Trang trọng hơn 'reduce'. Rất ăn điểm trong IELTS Writing.

words.example: For many modern citizens, the countryside is not as accessible as it once was and is in fact a dwindling resource.
words.collocation: dwindle in size · dwindle rapidly · numbers dwindle
words.note: Mang sắc thái tiêu cực, nhấn mạnh sự suy giảm dần dần.
